slug: 2026-04-12 Côte d'Ivoire convenes strategic seminar to align digital transformation agenda

facts.fact: A seminar on 2026-04-12 in Yamoussoukro, led by Minister Djibril Ouattara, discussed harmonising existing national strategies including the National Artificial Intelligence Strategy, treated as an existing strategy.

systems.owner: Ministry of Digital Transition and Technological Innovation
